newsitem.title: USA: IBM rebounds after recent declines.
newsitem.headline: IBM rebounds after recent declines.

text.p: Stock in International Business Machines Corp. rose sharply Tuesday as it began to recover from a recent decline in recent days due to a jittery stock market.
IBM rose $3.25 to $151.875 in heavy trading, but traders and analysts said there were no particular events to drive the stock except the rise in the Dow Jones industrial average.
"It was down four (dollars) yesterday. Today, it's acting more like a Dow stock than a technology stock," one trader said. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 39.98 points to 6,308.33 Tuesday.

On Monday, IBM and other technology stocks dropped sharply after investment bank Morgan Stanley's global strategist, Barton Biggs, reduced the amount of stocks and raised the amount of cash and bonds in Morgan's global asset allocation portfolio.

Technology stocks were also off on jitters about fourth-quarter sales of personal computers to consumers after Circuit City Inc. reported lower-than-expected third quarter earnings and worse-than-expected PC sales.
"It's the nature of this market," said Jay Stevens, a Dean Witter analyst. "The fundamentals haven't changed in the course of a day or two."
